_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. iTunes Search is keyless and seller-site email scrape is light HTTP, so compute per lead is tiny. High volume, low prices. First 10 qualified_lead per run are free for validation.

listing.eventDescription: One iOS app with name, seller, category, ratings, and price, but no developer website.

lead.eventDescription: An app with the developer website, plus seller, category, ratings, review count, and price.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: An app with a scraped contact email and ratings at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, established developer. The first 10 qualified_lead per run are free so you can validate output.
